title: Sparkly tent
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='85' rx='42' ry='7' fill='#3a7d44'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='85' rx='42' ry='7' fill='none' stroke='#5cb85c' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- tent body -->
  <polygon points='50,25 18,80 82,80' fill='#e8563f'/>
  <!-- tent left panel shade -->
  <polygon points='50,25 18,80 50,80' fill='#d4452f'/>
  <!-- tent opening -->
  <polygon points='50,38 38,80 62,80' fill='#2b1a4a'/>
  <!-- tent opening glow -->
  <polygon points='50,42 41,80 59,80' fill='#4a2d7a'/>
  <!-- tent pole -->
  <line x1='50' y1='25' x2='50' y2='80' stroke='#f7d060' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- tent peak flag -->
  <polygon points='50,25 50,16 62,20' fill='#f7d060'/>
  <!-- tent base trim -->
  <polygon points='18,80 82,80 80,83 20,83' fill='#f7d060'/>
  <!-- tent seam lines -->
  <line x1='34' y1='80' x2='50' y2='30' stroke='#f29b8a' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='66' y1='80' x2='50' y2='30' stroke='#f29b8a' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#ffe066'>
    <polygon points='12,30 14,25 16,30 14,35'/>
    <polygon points='85,22 87,17 89,22 87,27'/>
    <polygon points='88,45 90,40 92,45 90,50'/>
    <polygon points='8,55 10,50 12,55 10,60'/>
    <polygon points='75,15 77,10 79,15 77,20'/>
    <polygon points='22,18 24,13 26,18 24,23'/>
    <polygon points='92,65 94,60 96,65 94,70'/>
    <polygon points='5,70 7,65 9,70 7,75'/>
  </g>
  <!-- small star dots -->
  <g fill='#fff3b0'>
    <circle cx='30' cy='14' r='1.2'/>
    <circle cx='70' cy='35' r='1.2'/>
    <circle cx='16' cy='42' r='1.2'/>
    <circle cx='84' cy='55' r='1.2'/>
    <circle cx='40' cy='10' r='1'/>
    <circle cx='60' cy='8' r='1'/>
    <circle cx='10' cy='20' r='1'/>
    <circle cx='90' cy='32' r='1'/>
  </g>
  <!-- extra sparkle crosses -->
  <g stroke='#fff3b0' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'>
    <line x1='78' y1='38' x2='82' y2='38'/>
    <line x1='80' y1='36' x2='80' y2='40'/>
    <line x1='20' y1='48' x2='24' y2='48'/>
    <line x1='22' y1='46' x2='22' y2='50'/>
  </g>
</svg>
